descriptions.back.jpg:
This is a vertical image of a setup card, likely from a board game, divided into three distinctive sections.

**Top Section (Artwork):** The top portion features a dramatic, illustrative artwork of a large, monstrous creature. It is a serpentine or insectoid construct, composed of segmented, metallic golden-brass plates and spikes, appearing semi-translucent and radiant from within. Its head is dragon-like with horns, mandibles, and glowing eyes, emerging from a turbulent, smoky golden cloud. Below the creature are dark, thorny vines with a faint pinkish-purple bio-luminescence, framing the bottom of the illustration. The lighting is intense and warm, radiating from the golden creature and clouds against a dark, shadowy background.

**Middle Section (Text Banner):** Below the artwork is a horizontal banner with a rounded top border and a straight bottom border. It has a textured, off-white, parchment-like background with a subtle honeycomb pattern. At the top center of this banner is a circle containing the bold black number "7". Below the circle is the title "SETUP" in all capital letters. Below that, centered, is the line of text: "o Magus of Cloaks gains four nemesis tokens." The font is a clear, dark serif font.

**Bottom Section (Flavor Text Banner):** Investigating the bottom third, we find another banner with an arched top border that fits beneath the middle banner, and a straight bottom border. It has a solid black background and contains two paragraphs of white, italicized text. The text reads:
"We live in darkness. Darkness and silence. Only when they come does the city seem truly alive. The torches break the shadows against the cave walls. The bells join our voices as we prepare for yet another onslaught."
The second paragraph reads:
"The Magus is a thing of darkness. With every blow, we merely peel away one cloak of shadow to reveal another. Its minions are but splintered shadows, each possessing no mind, no life. In a world as bleak as this, could there be no greater master?"
Below that, in smaller, capital letters, is the attribution: "INDIRA, BREACH APPRENTICE". The font for the main text is a decorative serif, while the name is a simpler sans-serif font. Below this banner is the very dark, almost black bottom edge of the card, showing some minor wear on the physical card's edge.
descriptions.front.jpg:
This image is a close-up photograph of a fantasy game card titled "MAGUS OF CLOAKS".

The top half of the card features a dark, fantastical illustration. The dominant subject is a large, monstrous creature made of glowing purple energy and armored carapace. It has a scorpion-like form with a long, segmented body, large claws, and horn-like protrusions on its head. Below this creature, a group of smaller, dark, cloaked figures with glowing eyes stand on a craggy, dark landscape. Wisps of purple smoke and magical energy rise from them. The background is a smoky, dark green and black cavernous environment, possibly a chasm or a dark magical realm. The overall art style is dark fantasy, with a focus on magical energy and monstrous forms.

Separating the artwork from the text below is an ornate, scroll-work border with a dark purple and green color scheme. Embedded within this border is a prominent dark purple circular emblem with a red border, containing the number "35" in white.

The bottom half of the card contains text against a textured off-white background that resembles aged parchment. The text is arranged in sections:

Below the title "MAGUS OF CLOAKS" and the number "35" circle, the left side has a section headed "UNLEASH", followed by the text:
"Magus of Cloaks gains two nemesis tokens.
OR
Gravehold suffers 2 damage."

To the right, under the heading "INCREASED DIFFICULTY", the text reads:
"RULES: Magus of Cloaks can never have less than three nemesis tokens or more than nine nemesis tokens."

Below these sections, under the heading "ADDITIONAL RULES", are two bullet points:
"• When Magus of Cloaks would be dealt damage, reduce that damage by the number of nemesis tokens he has. Then, Magus of Cloaks loses one nemesis token.
• Magus of Cloaks can never have less than two nemesis tokens or more than eight nemesis tokens."

The entire text section is enclosed within a similar ornamental border as the one separating the artwork, forming the bottom edge of the card.
